discription: A warm pad sound using a saw wave and a slow ADSR envelope, with adjustable envelope times.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=1.0, decay=2.0, sustain=0.7, release=3.0;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = Saw.ar(freq) * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
